mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE role = 'USER' AND NVL(is_blocked, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCER WHERE is_verified = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCER WHERE is_verified = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, pr.biz_name AS producerName, p.created_date AS createdDate FROM PRODUCT p JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id WHERE NVL(p.status, 'ON') <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY p.created_date DESC, p.product_id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, pr.biz_name AS producerName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount, MAX(o.order_date) AS lastOrderDate FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id -- 주문 상태 필터 넣고 싶으면 여기서 추가 (예: 결제완료 이상만) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, pr.biz_name ORDER BY MAX(o.order_date) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, MIN(oi.product_name) AS productName, MIN(pr.biz_name) AS producerName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE TRUNC(o.created_date) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30 AND oi.order_status IN ('A1','A2','E1','E2','E3') GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total_amount) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pr.producer_id AS producerId, pr.biz_name AS producerName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE TRUNC(o.created_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND oi.order_status IN ('A1','A2','E1','E2','E3') GROUP BY pr.producer_id, pr.biz_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total_amount) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT pr.producer_id AS producerId, pr.biz_name AS producerName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE TRUNC(o.created_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND oi.order_status IN ('A1','A2','E1','E2','E3') GROUP BY pr.producer_id, pr.biz_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.line_total_amount) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDERS_ITEM oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE TRUNC(o.created_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND oi.order_status IN ('A1','A2','E1','E2','E3')

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(o.created_date), 'MM/DD') AS dateLabel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDERS_ITEM oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE TRUNC(o.created_date) BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (#{days} - 1) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND oi.order_status IN ('A1','A2','E1','E2','E3') GROUP BY TRUNC(o.created_date) ORDER BY TRUNC(o.created_date)

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(o.created_date, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') AS dateLabel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDERS_ITEM oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE TRUNC(o.created_date, 'MM') >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), - (#{months} - 1)) AND TRUNC(o.created_date, 'MM') <= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND oi.order_status IN ('A1','A2','E1','E2','E3') GROUP BY TRUNC(o.created_date, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(o.created_date, 'MM')
